representations.name: degree-coded point-private bipartitions
representations.new_information: Encodes all incidences at an arbitrary host vertex x with r=ceil(log_2(deg(x)+1))+1 private prime coordinates while keeping one shared point product.
representations.first_test: Count unordered nontrivial bipartitions and test whether one globally uniform r based on maximum degree suffices.

representations.name: bounded-dimensional exponent codes
representations.new_information: Tests whether a fixed number of primes with complementary exponents can replace logarithmic-size prime blocks.
representations.first_test: Lower-bound the exponent range required for Delta distinct incident-edge codes and compare it with the K-bit band budget.

representations.name: prime-valuation circuit matrix
representations.new_information: Views every path relation as an integer-kernel vector of its prime-valuation matrix and exposes support minimality over all rational coefficients.
representations.first_test: Use one private prime from each path label to solve every kernel equation and determine the full kernel dimension.

representations.name: toric hypergraph encoding comparator
representations.new_information: Compares the proposed arithmetic realization with known encodings of integer-matrix circuits by 0/1 hypergraph incidence matrices.
representations.first_test: Check whether the existing toric encoding theorem also supplies injective integer labels in one band and preserves host transversal and matching numbers.

representations.name: linear-hypergraph footprint realization
representations.new_information: Uses one- and two-block odd-prime footprints to preserve the complete pairwise edge-intersection pattern of any simple linear host.
representations.first_test: Enumerate every shared/private collision type and isolate exactly where linearity is needed.

representations.name: set-intersection graph representation comparator
representations.new_information: Tests whether classical set-intersection representations already imply the stronger relation-level arithmetic realization.
representations.first_test: Compare adjacency-only preservation with exact shared vertices, primitive equal-product circuits, and cover/matching preservation.

representations.name: variable-edge dyadic balancing flow
representations.new_information: Treats each edge independently with an explicit quotient-remainder decrement vector whose maximum is four whenever its size exceeds K.
representations.first_test: Display the vector, prove its sum and maximum, and verify equality of total two-adic exponents for every edge size m>K.

representations.name: small-edge and multi-prime padding comparators
representations.new_information: Tests whether the minimum-edge-size condition can be removed by a different distribution of scale corrections.
representations.first_test: For m<=K, optimize decrement capacities and determine whether fixed-band nonnegative exponents can be guaranteed under the same raw-value budget.
